scope: Canonical skill verification promotion manifest for Expert Missions 16-20
purpose: Record which existing canonical skill identities have enough current acquisition evidence to carry Expert Mission acquisition metadata without falsely asserting guaranteed drops or exact rates.

promotion_policy.identity: Existing seeded skill identity must already exist in skills.json.
promotion_policy.category: Current category evidence must agree with the canonical class/subcategory.
promotion_policy.acquisition: Mission-to-skill association may be recorded as partially_verified when current references agree, even if exact drop mechanics remain unresolved.
promotion_policy.guarantee: Do not mark an Expert Mission skill as a guaranteed per-clear reward without explicit evidence.
promotion_policy.drop_rate: Do not populate a numerical drop rate from player reports or inference.
promotion_policy.historical_conflict: Retain older conflicting names or values as historical evidence rather than silently rewriting them.
